description: THIS FILE GOVERNS THE PUBLIC MIRROR, caracal-lynx/sluice — NOT THIS REPOSITORY. mirror.yml runs `git subtree split --prefix=packages/sluice` and force-pushes the result, so packages/sluice/ becomes the mirror's repository ROOT and this file lands there as the root renovate.json. Renovate reads config only from a repository root, so it is inert for data-gubbins: the config that governs THIS repo is /renovate.json, and nothing here narrows or overrides it.

Renovate must not run on the mirror. The mirror is a read-only publication of packages/sluice whose master is force-pushed on every `@caracal-lynx/sluice@*` tag, so any branch or lockfile Renovate creates there is destroyed by the next release. Nor could its PRs ever merge: the mirror has no ci.yml, so the required status checks never arrive and every proposal parks in 'Pending Status Checks' forever. Eight were left frozen that way on sluice#61.

The mirror also inherits NONE of the holds in /renovate.json, because those live in this repo's root config and the subtree split does not carry them. Left to run, Renovate would offer the mirror exactly the versions this repo deliberately refuses — read-excel-file 9.3.5 among them, which stops surfacing Excel error cells and turns a failed formula into an indistinguishable blank (DAG-261).

Renovate has in fact been dormant on the mirror since 2026-07-30, when sluice#284 merged a top-level `enabled: false` for the monorepo migration window (DAG-211). That pause de-scheduled the repo in Mend and de-scheduling is sticky — reverting the config does not thaw it. But the renovate.json carrying it sat at the mirror's root and was therefore wiped by the very next mirror force-push, because it did not exist under packages/sluice here. Since then the pause has survived ONLY as invisible Mend-side state, with nothing in version control to explain it and nothing to re-assert it if the repo is ever force-thawed in the portal. This file is that record.

Not shipped to npm. packages/sluice/package.json `files` is an explicit allowlist (dist, README.md, LICENSE, docs/licensing-faq.md, CLAUDE.md, PLUGINS.md), so this file reaches the public repository but never the published tarball.

To genuinely re-enable Renovate on the mirror, deleting this file is NOT sufficient: a de-scheduled repo is only thawed by a force in the Mend portal. Do both, and only after the mirror has CI that can satisfy a required status check.
